blueprint.name: Procedural Asset Studio
steering: Applied knowledge, man. Build it out with the funnel.
blueprint.inheritedIntent: Expand seeded procedural assets for frames, fonts, talking/blinking/gaze faces, wipers, foliage, photo motion wrappers, opening windows/curtains/blinds/light, bugs and swarms, fitted glass aquariums, wheels/trails, soft human/alien/animal/bug motion, modeler composition, 3D authoring and Morverse integration. Compact math not stored frames. No game/real-life separation. No lenses. Preserve previous Effects Studio.
questions: What useful outcomes must a saved generator reproduce across time, hosts, and future engine versions?
Which existing MOOR capabilities should own authoring, private storage, distribution, and world placement?
What is analytic and which inputs need explicit source assets?
How do new families become discoverable without custom feed glue?
How can creators retain autonomy, responsive previews, accessible controls, and portable work as the catalog grows?

reuse.authoring: Extend Forge and Studio; package-ready standalone app with integrity-checked MoorPack export
reuse.feed: Wonder Haven descriptors and existing lifecycle
reuse.world: Fall From Grace PluginHost graphics grant; bounded deterministic placement
reuse.aquarium: Reuse original Aquarium caustic GLSL and plant sway equation; preserve original simulation

math.seed: Integer item/channel hash, stable IDs across LOD
math.time: Absolute seconds, bounded analytic motion, temporal trail samples
math.space: Local unit frame, dimensions, per-layer transform and model primitives
math.face: Blink pulse, gaze trajectory, explicit mouth envelope/phoneme; no inferred speech claim
math.aquarium: Elliptical fish schools, articulated tail, bubbles, caustic water/glass sized to host
math.softBody: Analytic elastic pose deformations, four morphologies and LOD; no collision solver claim
math.fonts: Seeded alphanumeric stroke grammar and SVG export; not a multilingual font engine

decisions: No lenses; clean orthographic/perspective camera and orbit/front/top presets
Strict recipe version, allowlisted parameters and byte/layer/object limits
Shared real WebGL scene in OS/Pulse/feed, dispose resources and pause hidden previews
Export JSON, SVG, transparent PNG and integrity-checked MoorPack; actual City placement plugin
Images remain explicit source blobs; optional modeler uses editable primitives
Explicitly saved recipes only; never scroll-time frame storage
Keep current entitlement/publishing boundaries and no invented currency
acceptance: All 30 families produce deterministic actual geometry
Save adds feed descriptors automatically and previews never write frames
Forge/Studio launch package-ready native app; City plugin accepts saved recipe with placement
Layer composition, model primitives, dimensions, LOD, seed, time, camera and mouth input work
Determinism, hostile JSON, geometry bounds, LOD and storage budgets checked
Both repos pushed with current-head lease; CI and live workflow evidence recorded

rerun.reason: Review cross-host replay, future engine changes, world placement and extension discovery.

futureValueReview.question: How can this continue providing the most value to as many people as possible for Sebastian far into the future?
findings: One family registry with parameter metadata, no arbitrary recipe code evaluation
Recipes include engine version; unsupported versions rejected until explicit migration
Private deliberate saves, source-image references distinct from compact mathematical recipes
Bound each object/layer/pixel, suspend hidden previews and preserve LOD identity
Portable package and world binding without fabricated ownership
futureValueReview.reason: Next useful evidence is implementation and rendered verification.
